messages:
alex: FYI ticket #8421 — customer (acme-inc) reporting per-model throughput sparklines in the Console are flatlined since ~03:10 UTC. API still returns responses, only the dashboard panels for per-model QPS are zeros. Screenshot -> https://files.redwood/acme/screenshot.png

lisa: Which models are affected? any specific model ids?

alex: They listed two: redwood/rtl-7b and gpt-sim-1. Totals on the overview page look normal, it's just the per-model lines that are missing.

maria: tagging eng-platform — I made a prometheus label migration yesterday to standardize label names (model -> model_name). Could be related.

maria: I pushed the exporter relabel to replace 'model' with 'model_name' but I missed adding a compatibility copy. :grimacing:

sam: Can you paste a raw metric scrape sample from the exporter?

maria: sample from /metrics (sanitized):

```
redwood_model_qps{model_name="redwood/rtl-7b",instance="gpu01:9100",env="prod"} 12
```

Old format used `redwood_model_qps{model="redwood/rtl-7b",...}`

alex: The Console panels query `label_values(redwood_model_qps, model)` — so if the label name changed, the panels will return empty lists. That matches the customer's symptom.

sam: Ok that explains it. Short-term mitigation: add a relabel rule in the exporter to copy model_name -> model so both labels exist.

maria: Rolling a tiny compat patch now. deploy-bot: deploy request prod/exporter-compat-copy v1.2.1 by maria

deploy-bot: Deployment started for prod/exporter-compat-copy v1.2.1. CI green.

sam: After the rollout, verify with `curl -s https://metrics.prod.redwood/exporter | grep redwood_model_qps | head` and ensure `model=` appears.

maria: Patch deployed to 3 replicas. Metrics now show both labels:

```
redwood_model_qps{model_name="redwood/rtl-7b",model="redwood/rtl-7b",instance="gpu01:9100"} 12
```

alex: I still see zeros in Grafana for those panels — might be caching on the Console side. Can someone force a datasource refresh / reload dashboards?

sam: I cleared the datasource cache and reloaded the dashboard config. Panels are rendering for me now, lines returned.

alex: Customer confirmed graphs came back around 03:37 UTC. They've been notified. Marking the ticket resolved for now.

lisa: Customer asked if this will happen again. What's the plan to prevent regressions?

maria: I'll add a CI test to the exporter repo to assert legacy labels exist (or aliasing) and add a migration playbook. Also opening a short RFC for label-change compatibility policies.

sam: I'll create an alert rule: if per-model panel returns zero for >10m while global QPS > 0, trigger an Ops notice (ENG-3254).

alex: Thanks everyone. Closing ticket after follow-up items created (ENG-3254, EXPORTER-77). :tada:
